question: Which divine weapons and lordly compassion identify the supreme being's sovereignty?
premises: The being holds the discus and bears the thunderbolt.
The being is the lord of gods.
The being is kind to the world.
inference: The supreme being wields divine power as lord of gods while remaining compassionate toward the world.
plain_english: He holds the discus, bears the thunderbolt, is the lord of gods, and is kind to the world.
